summary: Candidate 3 closes both candidate-2 specialty-9 findings. All preregistered evaluator thresholds and escalation boundaries passed the focused suite and a 19-case independent probe. Incomplete and complete evaluator outputs always emitted unfinishedUnitIds, sourceBlockedUnitIds, affectedFamilyEscalationCandidates, and the approximately-199 unaudited-population boundary. Recurring material roots over three concise-rule units and across concise-rule/FAQ families populated the exact affected families and required full-audit escalation.

evidence.detail: The incomplete branch computes unfinished units, final source blockers, affected families, and the unaudited boundary before returning.
The complete branch emits unfinishedUnitIds as an empty list together with source blockers, affected families, and the unaudited boundary.
The focused regression exercises a partially complete report with a final source blocker and a fully complete report.
Independent cases covered all-pending, all-compared, partially final, complete-pass, and complete-failure reports; every assertion for all four reporting fields passed.
Material-or-critical root-to-unit and root-to-family maps retain recurring causes at three units or two families.
Recurring-root units, unresolved core material units, blockers, component material units, critical units, authority overrides, and hidden defaults all contribute to affected-family enumeration.

Three concise-rule units sharing RC-CORE-SAME-FAMILY produced affected family concise-rule; one concise-rule plus one FAQ unit sharing RC-CORE-CROSS-FAMILY produced exactly concise-rule and faq. Both cases required full-audit escalation.

verifiedThresholds.cleanPass: A fully clean 140-unit fixture passed audited units only with all failure lists empty, no full escalation, and a 23-unit deterministic clean-match sample.
verifiedThresholds.critical: A critical discrepancy failed and required full escalation.
verifiedThresholds.authorityOverride: An authority inversion populated inventedAuthorityOverrides and required full escalation.
verifiedThresholds.hiddenDefault: A hidden default populated hiddenDefaults and required full escalation.
verifiedThresholds.recurringSameFamily: One material root over three concise-rule units recurred, failed, required full escalation, and identified concise-rule as affected.
verifiedThresholds.recurringAcrossFamilies: One material root over concise-rule and FAQ units recurred, failed, required full escalation, and identified both families.
verifiedThresholds.nonrecurringBoundary: Two units in one family sharing a root did not meet the recurrence threshold.
verifiedThresholds.coreMaterial: An isolated core material error failed the audited-unit gate and identified its family without independently requiring full escalation.
verifiedThresholds.componentMaterialLimit: One and exactly two isolated component material errors stayed within the declared maximum; three exceeded it, enumerated all three units, and required full escalation.
verifiedThresholds.sourceBlocked: A source-blocked unit failed, appeared in both blocker enumerations, and identified its family.
verifiedThresholds.coexistence: Critical, blocked, and component-material evidence coexisted without masking; the critical and blocker lists and both affected families were retained.
verifiedThresholds.cleanSample: A complete clean sample selected 23 units; a missing component family produced the expected 22-versus-23 mismatch; an unverified selected match failed separately.
verifiedThresholds.invalidClassification: A nonmatch with none severity failed direct evaluation and required fail-closed escalation.
verifiedThresholds.reportContract: All incomplete and complete probe outputs contained unfinishedUnitIds, sourceBlockedUnitIds, affectedFamilyEscalationCandidates, and claimScope with the 199-unaudited boundary.

testsRun.result: passed; 19/19 bounded evaluator cases and all report-contract assertions
expected exit 2 for the all-pending audit; structural validation passed and the emitted incomplete report contained all four required reporting fields
passed; tracked repository state remained clean

residualRisks: Stable rootCauseId assignment remains a semantic verifier/integrator responsibility; mechanical recurrence detection cannot prove that one real cause was not split across cosmetic IDs.
The pure evaluator assumes the structurally validated result/comparison maps supplied by its command-line entry point; prelock structural validation and mutation controls passed that boundary.
issuesEncountered: The first run of the outside-repository probe used the wrong FAQ unitClass literal and stopped before evaluating candidate behavior; the probe was corrected to base-applicable-faq-unit and then all 19 cases passed.
